summary: Kodiak Gas Services, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on May 13, 2026, for an underwritten public offering of $750 million of common stock (par value $0.01), with an underwriter option for an additional $112.5 million. The offering price per share was to be determined at pricing, with a May 12, 2026 stock price of $75.14. No specific terms (price, discount, closing date) were finalized. This is a routine capital markets transaction — a secondary or primary equity offering — not a special situation, as it does not involve a merger, tender, activist, or restructuring event. The underwriters include Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan.
